items.guidance: Nango is a monorepo, so look for the server package's compiled entry under its dist output (produced by `rimraf ./dist && tsc`), for example a server package's main field, and check any docker-compose files or self-hosting docs for the command they use. If the Dockerfile is shared across services (server, jobs, runner, persist, orchestrator), make the CMD start only the web-facing server process that listens on the load-balanced HTTP port and serves the health check path.
